options.label: a martial weapon and a shield

notSimulated: Multiclassing is deferred until after v1.

options.name: Archery
options.summary: +2 bonus to attack rolls you make with ranged weapons.

options.name: Blind Fighting
options.summary: Blindsight out to 10 feet. Within that radius you can perceive creatures that are invisible or hidden.

options.name: Dueling
options.summary: While wielding a melee weapon in one hand and no other weapons, +2 damage with that weapon.

options.name: Great Weapon Fighting
options.summary: When you roll a 1 or 2 on a damage die for a melee weapon wielded with two hands, reroll it and use the new roll.

options.name: Interception
options.summary: When a creature you can see hits another creature within 5 feet, use your reaction to reduce the damage by 1d10 + PB. You must be wielding a shield or a simple or martial weapon.

options.name: Protection
options.summary: When a creature you can see attacks a target other than you within 5 feet, use your reaction to impose disadvantage. You must be wielding a shield.

options.name: Thrown Weapon Fighting
options.summary: +2 damage with thrown weapons. A thrown weapon's normal range increases by 10 feet.

options.name: Two-Weapon Fighting
options.summary: Add your ability modifier to the damage of the second attack when you fight with two weapons.

options.name: Unarmed Fighting
options.summary: Unarmed strikes deal 1d6 bludgeoning (1d8 if you aren't wielding weapons or a shield). At the start of each of your turns, deal 1d4 bludgeoning to one creature you are grappling.

features.name: Martial Proficiency
features.summary: Ignore the Strength requirement of armor you are proficient with. With a weapon you are proficient with, use Strength or Dexterity for the attack and damage rolls.

features.name: Second Wind
features.summary: Spend 1 Exertion as a bonus action to regain 1d10 + your fighter level hit points.

features.name: Action Surge
features.summary: Spend 2 Exertion on your turn to take one additional action.

features.name: Weapon Group Mastery
features.summary: Choose two weapon groups (axes, blades, bludgeons, bows, crossbows, polearms, or thrown weapons). A hit with a mastered group deals extra damage equal to your proficiency bonus, using the Mastery Damage budget. At 6th level choose a third group; at 13th level choose a fourth.

features.name: Veteran's Focus
features.summary: When you finish a short rest, regain 1 expended Exertion in addition to the Exertion you normally regain.

features.name: Tactical Assessment
features.summary: As a bonus action, study one creature you can see within 30 feet. Until the end of your next turn, you have advantage on attack rolls against it, and the first weapon hit on your turn deals extra damage equal to your proficiency bonus. Uses equal your proficiency bonus, regained on a long rest.

features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.summary: Increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1, to a maximum of 20. Also at 8th, 12th, 16th, and 19th level.
features.noEffect: Ability score choices are character build, not a combat action.

features.name: Extra Attack
features.summary: When you take the Attack action on your turn, you can attack twice instead of once.
